faq.proposed: Q: What is a freight forwarder TMS? A: A freight forwarder TMS (transportation management system) is software built around how forwarders actually work: multimodal shipment execution, quoting and rate management, documentation, compliance filing, billing, and customer visibility in one system. GoFreight is AI powered freight forwarding software that covers this entire forwarder TMS workflow, from email intake to document processing to quoting.
faq.rationale: The definitional query behind the whole cluster. Descartes answers it in a dedicated H2; GoFreight can answer it in the FAQ without redesigning the page.

faq.proposed: Q: How is a forwarder TMS different from a general TMS? A: A general TMS is built for shippers and carriers to plan loads and manage fleets. A forwarder TMS is built for freight forwarders who sell and execute international shipments, so it centers on quoting, ocean and air documentation, compliance filings, partner settlement, and customer facing tracking. GoFreight covers this full forwarder workflow in one platform.
faq.rationale: Disambiguation question that AI assistants ask and answer constantly; owning it positions GoFreight in the forwarder TMS category rather than the crowded general TMS category. Matches the TMS vs FMS anchor discipline: never blur distinct categories.
